_comment: Which releases are signed, for the front door prototype's signed-card dressing (docs/design/front-door.md, section 3.1). A release counts as signed here when its GitHub release carries both files `just sign-release` uploads, release-manifest.json and release-manifest.json.sig.json (the same test src/updater.rs uses to decide which releases to offer; the desktop then checks both signatures before installing). Read from the GitHub releases API on 2026-11-02, by hand, for the prototype only: signed_at is when the signature file was uploaded. It stands in for the `signed` field the real /api/front-door answer would give each update, which the relay would learn by checking the signatures itself. The visitor's browser never asks GitHub.
